name: dealpme
description: DealPME : place de marché de transmission et reprise de PME (zone OHADA, pilote Togo). Monorepo TypeScript.

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w packages/domain -w packages/contracts -w packages/i18n -w packages/testing -w codebases/engine/rules -w codebases/frontend/ui && npm run build --workspaces --if-present --include-workspace-root=false -- --pretty false >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w codebases/engine/rps -w codebases/backend/api -w codebases/backend/worker -w codebases/frontend/web
